newsitem.title: INDIA: India Reliance first half taxes "nil".
newsitem.headline: India Reliance first half taxes "nil".

text.p: India's top private firm Reliance Industries said on Friday taxes for the first six months of the fiscal ended March 31, 1997 were "nil", adding it would make required provisions only at the year-end.

"In view of the substantial ongoing capital expenditure programme, the company has been advised that its income tax liability will be determinable only at the year end," the company said in a statement.
"Therefore, provision for taxation, as applicable, will be made at the end of the year." it said.
Reliance was expected to provide for a 12.9 percent minimum alternate tax announced in India's 1996/97 budget in July.
